reference.title: To mark fields for deletion
reference.shortdesc: Maanasa Suthrave Go to Document > Fields .

ol.li: Right-click on a field and select Mark for Deletion.
Click Yes on the confirmation dialog that appears. The field is marked with a strikethrough in the document and the Document pane to denote that it has been marked for deletion.
Complete this action.Check-in the document and choose Reconcile. The field is removed from the document.
